title: Unbounded module rendering on every page
summary: Modules render expensive queries or transformations site-wide regardless of page context.
rationale: Site-wide modules multiply compute and database work across unrelated page requests.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Constrain modules by menu/page context and cache expensive module output.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
